claims: Nancy Guthrie is the mother of Today host Savannah Guthrie.
As of early April 2026, the search for Nancy Guthrie continues.
Nancy Guthrie was abducted from her Tucson, AZ home on February 1.
A masked figure was spotted in home surveillance.
The FBI and Pima County Sheriff’s Department are actively investigating the incident as a kidnapping.
Authorities found evidence suggesting a struggle.
Surveillance captured a masked figure at the home on Feb 1.
The family has offered a $1 million reward for information leading to her safe recovery.
Savannah Guthrie returned to the Today show on April 6
